facades.name: east-north-east front (Jacob Obrechtstraat)
facades.note: Openings as the tool reads them (glass and dark openings; the white blind-arcade panels and the wooden doors are not openings to it). Bottom to top: three slit windows a tower; three tall windows a tower and the rose; the clock dial on the south tower; five belfry openings a tower. Columns: the belfry axes (five a tower) plus the rose. Gables: the two helms and the front gable. The clock and the parish hall beside the south tower make the front asymmetric; alongM crops the hall off (it stands 9 m in front). The photo also shows six white arcade arches a tower plus one over each side door (modelled, not counted here).
